articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Walk-off loss puts playoff celebration on hold
articles.description: The Red Sox will have to wait until Sunday - at least - before clinching a wild card spot.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras buoyed by improvement in right hand, no longer fears fracture
articles.description: There was some good news for the Red Sox first baseman as he recovers from a bruise to his right hand.

articles.title: Red Sox win included tone-setting homer, resurgent DH and rocky save (Notebook)
articles.description: Roman Anthony reminded everyone what he's capable of doing from the leadoff spot with a homer and two-run single Friday. Plus, Jahmai Jones snaps out of it and Erik Miller struggles to the finish line.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Ranger Suarez sets a career high in walks, but navigates tightrope in win
articles.description: It wasn't the cleanest outing for Ranger Suarez, but it was plenty good enough to get a win.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Roman Anthony (3 RBI) leads way as playoff clincher draws closer
articles.description: The Red Sox opened a series with the first-place Rays by jumping on the home team early.

articles.title: Red Sox’ injury update: The latest on Willson Contreras, Aroldis Chapman, Garrett Crochet and Eli White
articles.description: The Red Sox can only sit and wait to learn about the availability of some key injured players as the final week of the season approaches.

articles.title: Top Red Sox prospect Franklin Arias described as freak athlete, smart, mature
articles.description: Romy Gonzalez has enjoyed spending time with Red Sox top prospect Franklin Arias, who Baseball America ranks No. 2 on its Top 100 list.

articles.title: State of the Sox: Missing offense needs to be found for postseason success
articles.description: The Red Sox are better defensively than a year ago, and the same can be said of their pitching. But with the postseason approaching, they need to score more, too.

articles.title: Matt Vautour: After a charmed 2025, Drake Maye, Patriots need to prove they can overcome adversity
articles.description: Unlike last season's smooth ride through a weak schedule, this year's Patriots face real adversity — and Sunday's game against Pittsburgh is their first real test.

articles.title: Johan Oviedo hopes to ‘have a shot to help the [Red Sox]’ any way he can
articles.description: The rehabbing Red Sox pitcher threw 2 1/3 innings in his first rehab outing since landing on the injured list in early April.

articles.title: From surgery doubts to 'huge swing,' Trevor Story is making his case for Red Sox
articles.description: In front of a group of family and friends so big he “kinda stopped counting” how many there were, Trevor Story delivered the signature moment of his season Thursday night.

articles.title: Why was Aroldis Chapman unavailable for Red Sox in win? Chad Tracy explains injury
articles.description: Aroldis Chapman wasn't available for the Red Sox despite the fact they had a one-run lead in the ninth inning Thursday. Chad Tracy explained why.

articles.title: Willson Contreras says hand injury 'felt like a fracture' as Red Sox await further testing after negative X-rays
articles.description: Willson Contreras is hoping for the best after experiencing intense pain after being hit in the hand by a pitch in the eighth inning of Thursday’s win — and initial X-rays suggest he might have avoided a doomsday scenario.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Trevor Story hits heroic homer in win; Willson Contreras leaves in serious pain
articles.description: A sleepy evening turned into an eventful one for the Red Sox in Texas — in good ways and bad. Seconds after Willson Contreras left the game in intense pain after being hit in the hand, Trevor Story hit a game-winning three-run homer.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Johan Oviedo reaches 98.5 mph in his first rehab start for WooSox
articles.description: Red Sox pitcher Johan Oviedo topped out at 98.5 mph during his first rehab start on Thursday for Triple-A Worcester.

articles.title: Red Sox keeping rotation 'open-ended' as playoff berth nears, Wild Card matchup looms
articles.description: The Red Sox will start Sonny Gray in Thursday’s series finale against the Rangers and lefty Ranger Suarez on Friday night at Tropicana Field. After that, it’s anyone’s guess — and that’s somewhat of a product of the situation the club finds itself in.
